subject.title: fix(msteams): bound SSO API JSON response reads to prevent OOM

question: Should maintainers accept replacing the SDK sign-in route delegates with the bounded local SSO handlers based on route-level proof, or require live Teams tenant proof before merge?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well tested at the route level, but it deliberately moves an SDK-owned auth flow into OpenClaw code and the contributor could not run a live tenant/Bot Framework OAuth validation.

options.title: Accept Route-Level Proof
options.body: Proceed with merge review using the current success, overflow, and USGov token-host tests as sufficient proof for this hardening change.

options.title: Require Live Tenant Proof
options.body: Ask for maintainer-run or credentialed live Teams/Bot Framework OAuth evidence before accepting the auth-route replacement.

options.title: Pause Route Replacement
options.body: Keep the branch open if maintainers want a broader SDK-parity plan before replacing the SDK sign-in delegates.

recommendation.title: Accept Route-Level Proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with merge review using the current success, overflow, and USGov token-host tests as sufficient proof for this hardening change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the SDK migration that owns the route behavior now being replaced and is the clearest owner for accepting the compatibility risk.
